result.summary: Found 3 issues related to text truncation and layout that affect readability and visual polish on this food delivery home screen.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated on the right edge, showing 'Tokumaru Ramei' with a cut-off letter.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the text container has adequate width or apply proper text wrapping/ellipsis handling so the full name displays correctly.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right screen edge, appearing awkwardly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding or partial-card peek styling so the truncated card looks intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon backgrounds differ between cards — one is white/outlined and another is dark/filled — creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon styling across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
